title: VS Code navigation and path-copy extension
summary: Multi-root discovery, remote URI support and safe asynchronous results improve workspace navigation.

dates.note: Exact project start/end dates remain unknown. Direct local source/history review on 2026-10-29 supplements the supplied October 5 snapshot and separately dated owner statements. Commit milestones and review dates are not project starts or release dates.

facts.text: Developed a VS Code Quick Open/path-copy extension with multi-root handling, remote URI support, frecency ranking, symbol navigation and stale asynchronous-result protection.

Prevented late file/symbol lookups from overwriting newer picker queries using revision tokens and picker identity checks; combined Git-aware multi-root file discovery with URI-preserving remote fallback and serialized frecency updates.
